# LAYOVER by Becca Ruffalo

## What it is
LAYOVER is a travel blog and destination guide site written by Becca Ruffalo. It covers European travel with a focus on curated city guides, weekend escapes, travel strategy, and bucket-list inspiration — all written from personal experience.

## Who it's for
Travelers who want thoughtful, specific recommendations rather than generic listicles. The site is especially useful for people planning trips to Spain, Portugal, and Italy, or looking for a structured approach to booking and planning travel.

## Author
Becca Ruffalo — travel writer and creator of LAYOVER. Based on personal travel experience across Europe and beyond.

## Most important pages

- Home: https://layoverbybecca.com/
- Milan City Guide: https://layoverbybecca.com/#milan
- Seville Guide: https://layoverbybecca.com/#seville
- Lisbon Guide: https://layoverbybecca.com/#lisbon
- Strategy & Booking Toolkit: https://layoverbybecca.com/#strategy
- Bucket List / Inspiration: https://layoverbybecca.com/#inspo
- About Becca: https://layoverbybecca.com/#about

## Site structure
LAYOVER is a single-page application. All content lives at https://layoverbybecca.com/ and is navigated via JavaScript. Hash fragments (e.g. #milan, #seville) indicate specific sections.

## Content focus
- Destination guides: Milan, Seville, Lisbon (with more planned)
- Weekend plans and short-trip ideas
- City guides hub
- Travel experiences and activities
- Strategy section: how to research, book, and plan trips
- Bucket list: curated dream destinations with an interactive map
